referenceSources.description:
A sleek black Lotus Exige S1, fully converted for track performance, is parked on a gravel surface beside a wooden fence. The car’s aerodynamic enhancements include a large rear wing, front splitter, and side vents, all finished in matching black. The wheels are lightweight black alloys, and the bodywork reflects the surrounding environment.

Behind the car, a sign on the fence reads “Reserved Parking For ITS Only,” indicating a designated spot. Industrial elements such as storage containers and wooden pallets frame the scene, emphasizing the car’s motorsport context.
